source.title: VAT rates on different goods and services

rows.measure: catering: food and drink eaten on the premises, all hot takeaways and home deliveries
rows.note: Standard-rated: 'Restaurants must always charge VAT on everything eaten either on their premises or in communal areas ... restaurants and takeaway vendors must charge VAT on all hot takeaways and home deliveries' (VAT Notice 709/1). Ice cream, confectionery, alcoholic and soft drinks are always standard-rated.

source.title: VAT rates on different goods and services (last updated 10 July 2026)

rows.measure: food and drink for human consumption sold cold (not catering), including cold takeaway food
rows.note: Zero-rated: 'Food and drink for human consumption is usually zero-rated' and cold takeaway food is not charged 'unless it's to be eaten in a designated area'. Always standard-rated: catering, alcoholic drinks, confectionery, crisps, hot food, ice cream, soft drinks (VAT Notice 701/14).

source.title: VAT rates on different goods and services (last updated 10 July 2026)

rows.measure: books, newspapers, magazines, printed music, maps; brochures, leaflets and pamphlets
rows.note: Zero-rated (VAT Notice 701/10); exercise books, letterheads and posters are standard-rated.

rows.measure: passenger transport in a vehicle, boat or aircraft that carries not less than 10 passengers
rows.note: Zero-rated (VAT Notice 744A); a vehicle for fewer than 10 passengers (a taxi) is standard-rated.

rows.measure: health services by registered doctors, dentists, opticians, pharmacists and other health professionals
rows.note: Exempt from VAT (VAT Notice 701/57): no VAT charged.

rows.measure: education and vocational training by an eligible body other than a private school
rows.note: Exempt from VAT when supplied by an eligible body (VAT Notice 701/30); private schools charge VAT since this change. Commercial tutors and schools that are not eligible bodies charge the standard rate.

rows.measure: admission to museums, art exhibitions, zoos and performances by public authorities or eligible cultural bodies

rows.measure: renovating a dwelling empty for at least 2 years; converting premises into more dwellings
rows.note: Reduced rate 5% (VAT Notice 708); other building work on existing homes is standard-rated.

rows.note: Reduced rate 5% only where grant-funded by certain funders (VAT Notice 708/6).
